I have been farming these 9.5 mu for many years. Let me think through each crop the way I always do — starting from what I did last year, and adjusting a little.

**Cotton (about 4 mu).** Cotton is my main crop. I buy Bt hybrid seed from the dealer in town — the kind most neighbors use, resistant to bollworm. I will plant after qingming when soil warms up. Last year I put about 40 jin urea and one bag of compound fertilizer (45%) per mu total across base and topdressing, so around 18 kg N, 7 kg P, 8 kg K per mu. I will do the same this year — cotton needs enough nitrogen or the bolls stay small. I plough in autumn, then rotary in spring. I water 3 times from the well: before planting, at flowering, and at boll-filling. Pesticide — even with Bt seed, I still spray 6 times for aphids, spider mites, and plant bugs. A normal year I get 270 kg seed cotton per mu.

**Cauliflower (about 2.5 mu).** I grow autumn cauliflower — transplant in July, sell in October-November when price is good at the county market. I use hybrid seedlings from the seedling house. Cauliflower eats heavy — I give it about 22 kg N, 10 kg P, 15 kg K per mu, plus 2 carts of farmyard manure as base. Water 7 times because heads crack if soil dries. Spray about 5 times for caterpillars and downy mildew. Good head, 2500 kg per mu.

**Stevia (about 3 mu).** Quzhou has a stevia buying station, contract price is decent. I use improved cuttings. Stevia does not need as much fertilizer — 13 kg N, 6 kg P, 9 kg K per mu. Water 4 times. Spray 2 times, mostly for leaf miners. I cut twice in the season, dry the leaves. About 300 kg dry leaf per mu.
